[Previous context: The project also provides assistance to the Agency for State Roads to improve its institutional
capacity, modernize its approach to the management of the road network and implement key elements of the new Public] Law on Roads.

Results achieved:

[Context: Results achieved:]
Regional roads: completed rehabilitation of 284km. Local roads: completed rehabilitation of 280 km.
Technical audits of completed road works carried out and their recommendations being followed up.
Institutional support to focused on (i) establishing a road asset management system; (ii) strengthening
ASR's organizational and decision making arrangements for discharging its mandate in line with the Law

on Public Roads; (iii) diagnostic review and recommendations for development of the Macedonia

[Context: on Public Roads; (iii) diagnostic review and recommendations for development of the Macedonia]
domestic construction industry; and (iv) training needs assessment and implementation being launched.
